title: An architecture-specific rebuild repaired 5080 transfers; the retained study is incomplete
summary: The November 8 Continuum warmups failed because its binary lacked sm_120 or PTX. Rebuilding the same LMCache source repaired exact transfers and all required screens. The November 9 report remains a running-campaign snapshot. Three completed native control cells had throughput intervals spanning parity and no CPU restoration activity.
scope: Same-source LMCache 0.3.6 rebuild; 393,216-byte bidirectional equality; 54 screening configurations and 22 matched blocks. B06 had 31 valid measurements out of 32 attempts and seven of eight complete blocks.
limitations: One candidate attempt had zero restores and preemptions and remains excluded. Confirmation, overhead, operational and final audits were not complete at this revision. No final campaign result or GPU-only cross-host attribution is claimed.
decision: Retain the binary capability finding and incomplete-study boundary. New-code 5080 qualification remains deferred, not silently inherited.

chart.caption: Retained interim 5080 control cells, whole-process paired log Student-t 95% intervals: 12 chat, 6 QA and 12 document pairs. No returning CPU restoration or eviction-affected returns; not a pressured-offload benefit or final campaign estimate.

correction: 2026-11-10: made the already reported interim control-cell estimates visible; no additional acquisition or completion claim.
